title: Type 2 diabetes | Sarah Hallberg | TEDxPurdueU
summary: Dr. Sarah Hallberg argues in a TEDx talk that type 2 diabetes can be treated and potentially reversed through diet, especially by restricting carbohydrates. TED flagged the talk as outside its guidelines and warned against taking it as medical advice.
why: Commenters recommend it as a clear explanation of carbs, insulin and hunger, and several say it led them to try low-carb eating.

quote.text: Dr. Sarah Hallberg provides compelling evidence that it can, and the solution is simpler than you might think.
